phases.title: Schema, Contract & Environment
phases.exit_gate: Repository clones cleanly in <15 min. All migrations run. Both domain seeds exist. OpenAPI spec has no missing endpoints. Daraja, ODPC, Africa's Talking applications submitted.

phases.title: Auth & Core Data Layer
phases.exit_gate: New member registers and receives JWT. Insurance member with non-zero premium lock sees correct 3-figure balance (total, locked, redeemable). Redemption above redeemable_glp returns POINTS_LOCKED_FOR_PREMIUM.

phases.title: Commission Engine & Payments
phases.exit_gate: Webhook to /v1/webhooks/sale/insurance produces correct pending ledger entries for all 11 ancestor levels. Daraja sandbox round-trip completes: dispatch → callback → confirmed state → member SMS notification.

phases.title: Dynamic Features — FCFS & Tier System
phases.exit_gate: Member with direct_slots_used=3 shares link; new member joins under correct FCFS-resolved oldest sub-member. Option C tier correctly aggregates Insurance + Publishing GLPs into totalGLP in balance response.

phases.title: Client Channels
phases.exit_gate: Feature phone user completes full USSD session: balance check (3 figures), referral link SMS'd via AT, airtime redemption confirmed. Printed Commission Statement renders in A4 with all 3 financial figures.

phases.title: Fraud Detection, Admin Dashboard & AI
phases.exit_gate: Simulated rapid-referral fraud (>5/day) detected, flagged, commission held, visible in admin queue within 5 minutes. AI Insurance product parser correctly extracts premium in KES hundredths from test PDF.

phases.title: Hardening & Production Launch
phases.exit_gate: Production smoke test: real member registers, real Insurance sale webhook fires, real commission calculated, real Daraja payout to M-PESA. ODPC registration confirmed before this test runs.
